result.summary: Found 2 major issues: incomplete content visibility in restaurant cards that prevents users from seeing full information.

issues.description: The bottom card in 'Popular right now' section is cut off - the restaurant name and delivery details are not visible, only the food image is shown
issues.suggestion: Ensure the full card content is visible by adjusting the card height or scroll container, or display the restaurant name above/overlaid on the image

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section shows 'Trattoria Piccol' which appears to be a truncated name
issues.suggestion: Either show the full restaurant name with proper text wrapping/sizing, or implement a tooltip to display the complete name on hover/tap
